summary: Frontend-only retest Fase 79 for finance & finance_manager personas after RBAC fix. All 8 requested flows PASSED: (1) finance sees cost-billing-panel + allin-amendment-box on KPR Exclude contract KTR/2026/0010; amendment dialog scheme select loaded 2 schemes (no allin-amend-scheme-error), submit enabled only with scheme + reason>=10, toast success, pending box shows 'Exclude -> All-in Standar' + reason + requester finance@sipro.co.id, and Setujui/Tolak hidden for requester. (2) finlead (finance_manager) sees pending with Setujui/Tolak; reject without note -> toast 'Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.' (backend 400, expected); approve with note -> toast success, cost panel switched to 'Skema All-in Standar' (pass-through Rp 9.5jt, developer-borne Rp 36jt), history row data-status=approved names finlead@sipro.co.id. (3) Separation of duty: finlead requested amendment on All-in Cash contract -> pending box WITHOUT approve/reject; superadmin then saw buttons and rejected with note -> history row data-status=rejected names superadmin@sipro.co.id. (4) /finance > Penagihan: kpr-tranche-reminder-panel visible for both finance and finlead with 4 kpr-tranche-reminder-row (incl. KTR/2026/0010 Akad & Retensi), no kpr-tranche-reminder-error; run -> '2 pengingat baru dikirim (4 tahap siap cair)', second run -> '0 pengingat baru' (idempotent per tahap). (5) Reminder reset after cancel (superadmin): record T1 Akad disbursement -> banner kpr-tranche-ready listed only Retensi; cancel with reason -> banner lists Akad again; run reminders -> '1 pengingat baru dikirim' (marker reset works). (6) cost-dialog-payee & cost-dialog-note present in 'Catat beban (AP)' dialog. No red console errors on any visited page (only the expected 400 from the intentional reject-without-note validation).

issues: Nominal (Rp) field renders as native number input with browser spinner arrows instead of a formatted/masked currency input (cosmetic, consistent with earlier phases)

critical_code_review_comments: AllinAmendmentBox.load() swallows GET /allin-amendments errors silently (.catch(() => {})) — an RBAC/network failure would render an empty box with no feedback; consider an error message like the schemes list already has.
TrancheReminderPanel returns null while rows === null; if the GET hangs the panel never appears and gives no loading indicator.
